title: Yin
capsule: Yin (殷) was one of the Eighteen Kingdoms Xiang Yu established north of the Yellow River in 206 BCE, granted to the Zhao general Sima Ang with its capital at Chaoge, in modern Qi County (Hebi) in northern Henan. Caught between the Han and Chu camps in the Chu–Han Contention, Sima Ang surrendered to Han Xin's advancing army in 205 BCE, and Yin's territory was absorbed into Han-controlled Henan. Its independent existence lasted only about a year.
